options.name: label
options.description: Legend text and accessible name of the group.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the legend; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: options
options.type: readonly { value: string; label: string; description?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

options.name: value
options.description: Initially selected values; also restored by reset().

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name shared by every checkbox.

options.name: description
options.description: Group help text referenced by the fieldset's aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: At least one option must be selected.

options.name: minSelected
options.description: Minimum selections once any option is selected (integer 1..options.length).

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the selection invalid.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: inputs
properties.description: The native checkboxes, in option order.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Selection differs from the initial selection.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the group at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic selection (no events); unknown values throw CHECKBOX_GROUP_OPTIONS.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a new option list keeps selections that still exist.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the selection changes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial selection and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

cssClasses.name: aui-field__label | __required | __description | __error
cssClasses.description: Shared field chrome (the label is the legend).

cssClasses.name: aui-checkbox-group__options | __options--horizontal
cssClasses.description: Option list and its horizontal layout.

cssClasses.name: aui-checkbox-group__box | __input | __mark
cssClasses.description: Checkbox box, native input, and check mark.
